en.name: Achar
en.summary: Achar is a South Asian pickle preserved by three things working together — heavy salt, a strong acid, and a layer of oil sealing the surface. A properly made, traditionally cured jar keeps in a cupboard for about 1 year. Once opened, or whenever you are unsure how it was made, refrigerate it and use it within about 1–3 months.
en.pantry: A traditional sun-cured achar is shelf-stable and lives in a cool, dry cupboard for about 1 year from purchase. What makes that safe is not the oil by itself: the governing principle for any pickle is a minimum, uniform level of acid throughout the mixed product to prevent the growth of botulinum bacteria. The oil excludes air above an already salted and acidified mass; oil poured over under-salted or under-soured vegetables is a hazard rather than a seal. Keep the oil covering the solids, topping the jar up with fresh mustard or sesame oil if the level drops, and keep water out.
en.fridge: The fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below is the safe default for any jar you are unsure about, and the right home for modern reduced-salt, low-oil or 'fresh' achar — about 1–3 months there. It is also where an opened jar belongs once the kitchen is warm and the jar is being dipped into daily. Watch for fizzing, a pushed-up lid or a yeasty smell; those mean an unwanted fermentation has started, and that jar goes out.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for achar and freezing is not the way to keep it. The oil separates and clouds, the fruit or vegetable pieces go soft, and none of it improves a preserve that is already designed to keep. If you have made a large batch, jar it properly with the oil covering the solids and refrigerate what you cannot store on the shelf.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould on the surface or on any piece standing above the oil
Fizzing, bubbling or a lid that has pushed up
A yeasty, alcoholic or rotten smell instead of a sharp, spiced, salty one
Pieces gone slimy or the oil turned cloudy and rancid-smelling
tips: Use a bone-dry spoon every time. Never a wet spoon, a used spoon, or fingers.
Keep the solids submerged; top up with fresh oil rather than letting pieces sit exposed.
Decant a big jar into a small one as it empties so there is less air above the surface.
If the label says low salt or 'fresh', treat it as a fridge product from the day you buy it.

faq.q: Does achar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A traditional, heavily salted and soured achar under oil does not — about 1 year in a cool cupboard. Low-salt, low-oil or fresh styles do, and so does any jar you are unsure about.

faq.q: How long does achar last after opening?
faq.a: In the fridge at 4 °C or below, about 1–3 months. A shelf-stable traditional jar can stay in the cupboard, provided it is kept dry and the oil covers the solids.

faq.q: Is the oil layer what preserves achar?
faq.a: No. Salt and acid preserve it; the oil only keeps air off an already preserved mass. Oil over under-salted, under-soured vegetables is a botulism risk, not a seal.

faq.q: Why did my achar go mouldy?
faq.a: Almost always water — a wet spoon, condensation, or pieces left standing above the oil. Keep everything dry and submerged.

zh.name: 印度油漬醃菜
zh.summary: Achar 是南亞的醃漬品，靠三件事同時作用來保存——大量的鹽、夠強的酸，以及表面那層封住空氣的油。製作得當、傳統日曬熟成的一罐，放在櫥櫃裡大約可放 1 年。開封後，或你不確定它是怎麼做的時候，請冷藏並在大約 1～3 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 傳統日曬熟成的 achar 是常溫可存放的，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃裡，從購買日起算大約 1 年。讓它安全的並不是油本身：所有醃漬品的通則是整體必須達到最低且均勻的酸度，才能抑制肉毒桿菌生長。油的作用是在「已經夠鹹、夠酸」的內容物上方隔絕空氣；把油倒在鹽不夠、酸不夠的蔬菜上，那是風險，不是封層。請讓油始終蓋過固形物，油位下降就補新的芥末油或芝麻油，並且絕對不要讓水進去。
zh.fridge: 只要你對某一罐沒有把握，4 °C 以下的冷藏就是安全的預設做法；現代低鹽、少油或標榜「新鮮」的 achar 更是非冷藏不可，大約 1～3 個月。廚房很熱、又每天都在挖的開封罐，也該放冰箱。留意冒泡、蓋子鼓起或酵母味，那代表不該發生的發酵已經開始，那一罐要丟掉。
zh.freezer: Achar 沒有冷凍期限，冷凍也不是保存它的方法。油會分離變濁，果肉或蔬菜會變軟，對一個本來就設計來耐放的醃漬品毫無幫助。一次做太多的話，請好好裝罐、讓油蓋過固形物，放不進櫥櫃的就冷藏。
spoilage: 表面或任何露出油面的塊料長出絨毛狀的霉
冒泡、起氣，或蓋子被頂起來
聞起來有酵母味、酒味或腐敗味，而不是嗆辣鹹香
塊料變得黏滑，或油混濁並帶油耗味
tips: 每次都用完全乾燥的湯匙。不要用沾水的、用過的湯匙，更不要用手。
讓固形物保持在油面以下；油不夠就補新油，不要讓料露出來。
大罐吃到剩一半時換裝小罐，減少上方的空氣。
標示低鹽或「新鮮」的產品，從買回來那天起就當成冷藏品。

faq.a: 傳統高鹽、高酸、油封的不用，陰涼櫥櫃大約 1 年。低鹽、少油或新鮮款一定要冰，任何你不確定的罐子也一樣。

faq.q: Achar 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏在 4 °C 以下大約 1～3 個月。傳統常溫款只要保持乾燥、油蓋過固形物，可以續放櫥櫃。

faq.q: 油層就是 achar 的防腐劑嗎？
faq.a: 不是。保存靠的是鹽和酸，油只是把空氣隔絕在已經醃好的內容物上方。把油倒在不夠鹹、不夠酸的蔬菜上，反而是肉毒桿菌的風險。

faq.q: 我的 achar 為什麼發霉了？
faq.a: 幾乎都是水——沾水的湯匙、冷凝水，或有料露在油面上。保持乾燥，並讓所有東西泡在油下。
